info.title: OpenSprite Agent Chat API
info.description: Authoritative local HTTP contract for conversations, bounded agent runs, semantic run events, and cancellation.

get.summary: Read bounded persisted event history in ascending sequence order
get.description: Same-origin local API. Returns at most limit events; nextAfterSequence is the last returned sequence only when more persisted events exist. A null cursor describes the current snapshot, not a guarantee that an active run has ended.

get.summary: List conversations in reverse update order

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

get.summary: List persisted visible messages in sequence order

post.summary: Persist one user message and start one agent run

get.summary: Replay and follow safe semantic events for one run

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Last processed positive event sequence for reconnect replay.

200.description: SSE frames whose data field is a RunEvent JSON object. Each frame id equals RunEvent.sequence and event equals RunEvent.type.

post.summary: Request cancellation of an active run

ResponseMode.description: Six current preferences plus read-only historical mode names retained on existing Runs and events.

reasoningResolution.description: Frozen before the first provider call; null for queued and historical Runs.

EmptyEventData.description: Legacy compaction start or run cancellation.

ModelAttemptEventData.description: One actual gateway attempt. Completed describes stream completion, not run success. No content or credentials. Provider-internal HTTP retries are not represented.

contextTokens.description: Optional conservative estimate of the input Context used by this model request. Omitted on legacy events.

contextLimitTokens.description: Optional effective Context limit selected for this model request. Omitted on legacy events.

inputBudgetTokens.description: Optional safe input budget after output and safety reserves. Omitted on legacy events.

toolNames.description: Sorted tool ids advertised for this model request. Omitted on legacy events.

maxAttempts.description: Configured continuation limit, or null for unlimited mode subject to backend safety bounds.

InvalidRequest.description: Request shape, identifier, cursor, or body is invalid.

NotFound.description: Conversation or run does not exist.

RunStartConflict.description: The selected model is unavailable or the conversation already has an active run.

RunNotActive.description: The run is already terminal and cannot be cancelled.

LocalStoreUnavailable.description: The local database, settings store, or encrypted credential store is unavailable.

InternalError.description: An unexpected local service failure occurred.
